## Attribution Notice

This is an independent coding environment based on the open-source Scratch editor. It is not an official Scratch product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Scratch Foundation.

Scratch is developed by the Scratch Foundation and its partners and affiliates. See https://scratch.org/.

## AGPL-3.0 Section 13 Corresponding Source Requirement

All modified Scratch editor source files are archived in `vendor/coding-lab-scratch/modified-files/` alongside the reproducible build pipeline `vendor/coding-lab-scratch/build-coding-lab-editor.mjs` and the verbatim `LICENSE` (AGPL-3.0).

**Pre-release compliance note**: Before making this modified editor publicly accessible over a network, Jaystarbliss Dynamic Institute must publish the corresponding modified editor source repository (or verifiable source archive) at a publicly reachable HTTPS URL and configure `VITE_CODING_LAB_SOURCE_REPO_URL` so the About/Attributions dialog links directly to that live source offer.
